cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

mechanism: Mistake packing away a spare king for resignation, then assign washing-up to the partner despite the actual loss.
confusable: Not merely enforcing a known bet: B2 must reveal the wrong copied surrender and A3 must refuse that interpretation.
comparison: Domestic chore bargaining differs from announcing an organizational cost.
seedUse: Retains chess/washing-up agreement but reverses the apparent loser through copied piece handling.
